# Measuring ML Impact Without A/B Testing: A Data Scientist's Approach

## Introduction

This article is part of the "Day in the Life of a Data Scientist" series, sharing some of the real-world problems data scientists work on daily. Today's question: How do we measure the impact of launching a machine learning model on business metrics when A/B testing can't be done due to operational constraints?

## The Problem

We have developed an algorithm that helps agents perform outreach to maximize sales. Ideally, we would measure its impact using an A/B test, comparing the sales between agents using the model and those who aren't. However, operational challenges made running an A/B test impractical.

## The Solution

The solution to this problem is to use Interrupted Time Series (ITS) analysis.
